more_info.question: Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Community Overview

data.answer:
The Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai is a luxurious residential enclave within Dubailand. It offers residents a unique living experience centered around polo sports and equestrian activities. This community is the first of its kind in the Middle East to fully integrate polo facilities with high-end residential living. The development is built around four international polo fields and boasts 500+ stables for horse enthusiasts, alongside modern arenas and an exclusive Riding School.

Residents can also enjoy a wealth of premium amenities, such as pools, cabanas, and fine dining establishments, with the added advantage of breathtaking views of the lush green polo grounds. The villas are positioned around the St. Regis Hotel, which adds a touch of hospitality and offers additional leisure and dining experiences. The resort is renowned for its polo lounge and the Arena Club House, which serve as social hubs for residents and visitors.

The Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club offers a collection of 122 villas that blend Andalusia-inspired architecture with modern interiors. The villas are available for lease and feature 3 to 5-bedroom layouts, providing ample space for families. Designed with high-end materials, these homes come with Italian kitchens, spacious master bedrooms, and floor-to-ceiling windows that offer spectacular views of the polo academy. Each villa also includes a maid’s room and rider’s room, making it ideal for those with domestic staff or equestrian enthusiasts.

Residents benefit from landscaped gardens, private balconies, and airy living spaces. These thoughtful designs ensure a harmonious balance between luxury and comfort. The properties are equipped with modern furnishing and are strategically located to offer easy access to Dubai’s key highways, ensuring smooth commutes to other parts of the city.

Properties for Rent in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

There are no properties for sale in the area, but you can find rental villas in the community. Renting a villa in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai is a popular choice for families and individuals seeking an exclusive lifestyle. The rental properties in this community are reasonably priced, considering the luxury and amenities provided.

  • 3-bedroom villas: AED 155,000 per year
  • 4-bedroom villas: AED 160,000 – AED 185,000 per year
  • 5-bedroom villas: AED 240,000 – AED 260,000 per year

These rental homes stand out with contemporary interiors, spacious layouts, and balconies offering panoramic views. With access to private pools, gardens, and equestrian amenities, tenants enjoy a serene lifestyle unlike any other.

more_info.question: What to Expect When Living in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

data.answer:
Residents at Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai enjoy an active and luxurious lifestyle with a wide range of leisure options, from polo matches to themed dining experiences. The serene environment makes it a family-friendly destination, while the gated layout ensures privacy and security. Events such as the Dubai Polo Gold Cup are hosted here, adding vibrancy to the community.

Public Transportation in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

Although the area is best navigated by car, public transport options are available nearby. The Dubai Sky Courts Bus Station is located just 7 minutes away, while the Creek Station on Al Khail Road (E44) is accessible within 27 minutes. Residents also have easy access to major highways like Emirates Road (E611) and Dubai Al Ain Road (E66), making commuting convenient.

Supermarkets in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

For residents of Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai, grocery shopping is convenient with a range of supermarkets available nearby. One popular choice is West Zone Fresh Supermarket, which can be reached within 15 to 18 minutes. 

Known for its diverse product offerings, West Zone Fresh caters to everyday needs, including fresh produce, meats, dairy products, and household essentials. The store also provides a variety of international products, appealing to the multicultural residents of the community. Its competitive prices and frequent discounts make it a go-to option for families.

Another excellent option is Carrefour, located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, just a 12 to 15-minute drive from the resort. Carrefour is renowned for its wide selection of groceries, electronics, clothing, and home essentials. It offers both international and local products, making it a convenient one-stop-shop for residents. With its frequent promotions and loyalty programs, Carrefour helps residents save on their monthly grocery bills. The store also provides fresh baked goods, seafood, and deli products, making it an ideal destination for high-quality ingredients.

Shopping Malls in and Near Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

One of the most convenient shopping destinations for residents is the Dubai Outlet Mall, located just 11 minutes away from Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai. This retail destination is known for offering discounts on over 1,200 premium global brands, making it ideal for bargain hunters. From fashion and accessories to home décor and electronics, the mall caters to various shopping needs. Dubai Outlet Mall frequently hosts promotions and seasonal sales, making luxury items more accessible. With multiple food courts and entertainment zones, the mall also serves as a leisure hub for families.

Another exciting option is Global Village, just 16 minutes away, which offers a unique shopping experience intertwined with culture and entertainment. Global Village features pavilions representing countries from around the world, where visitors can explore handcrafted items, clothing, and cuisine from different cultures. Beyond shopping, Global Village offers carnival rides, live performances, and cultural shows, making it a popular attraction for residents and tourists alike. It operates seasonally, usually from October to April, and provides a festive atmosphere perfect for family outings.

For residents seeking a more intimate shopping experience, Circle Mall on Al Qudra Road is an excellent choice, located 25 minutes from the resort. Circle Mall features a variety of retail outlets, from fashion and lifestyle stores to supermarkets. It offers a relaxed shopping environment, with several dining options, coffee shops, and essential services. The mall also includes a rooftop pool and fitness center, adding to its appeal for locals. Whether for daily essentials or weekend leisure, Circle Mall provides a quieter alternative to Dubai’s larger shopping complexes.

Schools in and Near Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

One of the top schools near Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai is King’s School Al Barsha, just a 17-minute drive away. This highly regarded institution follows the British curriculum and caters to students from Foundation Stage to Year 13.

Another prestigious school nearby is Repton School Dubai, located in Nad Al Sheba. This boarding school offers both day and boarding options, making it a convenient choice for families seeking flexibility. Repton follows the British curriculum and offers the International Baccalaureate (IB) program, ensuring students have access to globally recognized education.

 GEMS Metropole School is another excellent choice, just 15 to 18 minutes from the resort. This school is known for its innovative approach to education, focusing on project-based learning and digital literacy. GEMS Metropole follows the British curriculum and offers comprehensive programs for students from Foundation Stage to Sixth Form.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

Residents of Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai have access to several religious facilities catering to various faiths. Mosques are conveniently located nearby, with Al Waha Mosque in Dubai Silicon Oasis only 14 minutes away. Additionally, the Remraam Mosques, located within the Remraam community, provide a peaceful environment for worship and are easily accessible via Emirates Road (E611).

For Christian residents, Dubai City Church is just 23 minutes away, offering a welcoming space for worship and community events. Situated in Bur Dubai, it provides services in multiple languages to accommodate Dubai’s diverse Christian population. Beyond Dubai City Church, other churches such as Christian Fellowship Church Dubai, Immanuel Assemblies of God Church, and Bible Baptist Church are also located in Bur Dubai, making it a convenient area for Christian worship.

Automech Gurudwara, a prominent Sikh temple, is located just 20 minutes away. It serves as a spiritual hub for the Sikh community, offering daily prayers, community meals, and religious events. For Hindu worshippers, temples such as the Sitladevi Temple and Zodiac Temple are located within 24 minutes on Umm Suqeim Street, offering spaces for rituals and prayers. 

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

Residents of Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai have access to several renowned medical facilities offering comprehensive healthcare services. Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, located just 18 minutes away, is a leading healthcare provider offering a wide range of services, from general check-ups to specialized treatments. 

Another well-known healthcare facility nearby is the Saudi German Hospital, located 20 minutes from the community in Al Barsha. This hospital is part of a reputable international healthcare chain, offering advanced medical services across multiple specialties, including orthopedics, neurology, cardiology, and women’s health.

For residents requiring advanced surgical procedures, the Burjeel Hospital for Advanced Surgery is just a 26-minute drive away. Known for its expertise in rheumatology, neurology, physiotherapy, and orthopedic surgeries, Burjeel is equipped with modern technology and staffed by some of Dubai’s top surgeons.

Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Location & Nearby Areas

Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai enjoys a strategic location in Dubailand, offering residents easy access to several well-established communities. The resort's proximity to major highways, such as Emirates Road (E611) and Dubai-Al Ain Road (E66), ensures seamless connectivity to key areas of Dubai, enhancing both convenience and lifestyle.

One of the nearest neighborhoods is the City of Arabia, a vibrant development known for its entertainment and retail attractions, including the IMG Worlds of Adventure, one of the largest indoor theme parks in the world. 

Nad Al Sheba lies to the northwest of the resort, known for its high-end residential villas and home to the Meydan Racecourse, a hub for horse racing enthusiasts. To the northeast is Academic City, a major educational district with prestigious universities and colleges, making it a convenient location for families with university-going children. International City, located further northeast, offers affordable retail outlets and globally themed residential clusters, providing residents with diverse shopping and dining experiences.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

data.answer:
Residents of Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai have access to a variety of exciting recreational activities, making the community a vibrant hub for outdoor enthusiasts and sports lovers. The polo fields are at the heart of the resort’s lifestyle, with year-round polo matches and lessons available for residents. Whether you are an experienced polo player or a beginner, the Polo Academy offers professional training to refine skills. Watching live matches from the comfort of the villas’ balconies or the polo lounge adds a unique charm to this community.

Beyond polo, the resort provides residents with opportunities to explore other equestrian activities at the Riding School, which houses more than 500 stables. Horse riding lessons are available for all skill levels, offering a chance to experience the joy of riding and engage in equestrian sports. 

Restaurants in and Near Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

Residents of Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai are spoiled for choice when it comes to dining options, with a variety of restaurants offering global flavors right within the community. One of the standout venues is The Grill Pit, an elegant restaurant specializing in South American cuisine.

Another favorite within the resort is Andalusia, which captures the essence of Mediterranean cuisine. With a beautifully designed setting featuring Mashrabiya-inspired screens and an arena-like courtyard, Andalusia offers a blend of flavors from Southern Europe and North Africa. 

For those looking to unwind with friends or enjoy a casual social gathering, The Polo Bar and Equestrian Lounge are the perfect spots.

Beaches Near Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

Although Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai is located inland, residents can easily access some of Dubai’s most popular beaches, all within a 30-minute drive. JBR (Jumeirah Beach Residence) offers a vibrant beachfront experience with water sports, restaurants, retail shops, and a bustling promenade. It’s an ideal spot for families and those looking to enjoy activities like jet-skiing, parasailing, or paddleboarding. Kite Beach is another favorite, known for its adventurous vibe and outdoor sports facilities such as beach volleyball courts and kite surfing areas. 

Hotels in and Around Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

Within the Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai community, residents and visitors can enjoy luxury accommodations at The St. Regis Dubai. This opulent hotel offers an exceptional stay experience, combining elegant interiors with top-tier amenities. 

Guests can indulge in fine dining at on-site restaurants, relax at the resort’s pools, and take advantage of the polo fields and equestrian activities.

For additional accommodation options nearby, Arabian Ranches offers several high-end hotels located just 15 to 20 minutes away. These hotels cater to both business and leisure travelers, offering comfortable stays with modern amenities. Many of these establishments feature family-friendly services, including swimming pools, spas, and children’s play areas.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club

Residents of Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai have access to several exciting attractions and landmarks that cater to diverse interests. One of the nearest attractions is Global Village, a vibrant cultural destination just 16 minutes away. Known for its international pavilions, live performances, carnival rides, and unique shopping experiences, Global Village offers a family-friendly outing where visitors can explore products and cuisines from around the world. 

Another popular destination is the Al Qudra Desert, offering residents a chance to immerse themselves in Dubai’s stunning natural landscapes. It’s a hotspot for outdoor enthusiasts, with Al Qudra cycling tracks, quad biking experiences, and stargazing opportunities. 

For golf lovers, the Legends Golf Course in the nearby Living Legends community is just a short drive away. This 9-hole course is perfect for casual and professional golfers, offering picturesque fairways surrounded by lush greenery. 

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Residents of Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai have access to a variety of outdoor activities and fitness facilities, ensuring a vibrant and healthy lifestyle. The resort is known for its polo fields, riding school, tennis courts, mini-golf areas, and archery range, offering plenty of opportunities for outdoor recreation. Whether it’s perfecting polo skills, taking horse-riding lessons, or enjoying friendly matches on the tennis courts, the resort ensures residents have access to exciting activities year-round.

For fitness enthusiasts, Nitro Gym, just 13 minutes away, offers a range of equipment for strength training and cardio, providing a modern workout experience. Female residents can also opt for Fitness4Life Ladies Gym, located 17 minutes from the resort, which offers tailored fitness programs in a supportive, women-only environment. 

When it’s time to unwind, residents can indulge in luxury treatments at Iridium Spa, conveniently located within the resort. The spa offers massages, facials, and beauty treatments, making it an ideal retreat after a long day. With a combination of fitness centers, outdoor activities, and relaxation services, Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club caters to both active and wellness-focused lifestyles.

This upscale, gated community is in high demand due to its prime location, providing villas at some of the most affordable rental rates. However, these luxurious villas are exclusively available for rent, with no ownership options.

more_info.question: FAQs About Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai

data.answer:
What types of properties are available in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club?

Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai offers luxurious 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas designed with Andalusia-inspired architecture. 

What security measures are in place in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club?

Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai prioritizes safety and privacy with 24/7 security services throughout the community. The gated layout ensures controlled access, with CCTV surveillance monitoring key areas to enhance security. 

Are there any properties for sale in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club?

Currently, The Residences at Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai Land are offered primarily for rent rather than purchase.

Are any apartments available in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club?

Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai is a villa community and does not have any apartments.

data.content:
Located in the heart of Dubailand, Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai offers an extraordinary lifestyle that blends equestrian sports, leisure, and modern luxury. Developed by Dubai Properties and led by Mohammad Al Habtoor, this upscale community is one of the region’s premier residential resorts. The destination is not only a haven for polo enthusiasts but also a desirable place to call home, with exclusive villas and an impressive range of amenities.

The Residences at Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club Dubai comprise a selection of opulent 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas, each thoughtfully designed to deliver exceptional comfort. This community attracts individuals and families seeking tranquility within a gated environment, along with the vibrancy of year-round polo matches. The development enjoys excellent connectivity with direct access to Emirates Road (E611), a key arterial highway linking various parts of Dubai, making it a top choice for residents who prioritize convenience and luxury.

Offering an unrivaled equestrian lifestyle, Al Habtoor Resort and Polo Club Dubai United Arab Emirates houses four polo fields, a Polo Academy, horse stables, and fine dining options. It hosts prestigious events such as the Dubai Polo Gold Cup Series and draws tourists and residents alike to its spectacular amenities. Whether renting or investing, this community promises a lifestyle filled with refinement and unparalleled leisure activities.
